summary: Becton Dickinson & Co filed an 8-K on May 20, 2026, reporting that its indirect subsidiary, Becton Dickinson Euro Finance S.à.r.l., issued €600 million aggregate principal amount of 3.855% Notes due 2033 in an underwritten public offering. BD fully and unconditionally guarantees the notes on a senior unsecured basis. The notes were issued under an indenture with a sixth supplemental indenture dated May 20, 2026; they are redeemable at the issuer's option before February 20, 2033 at a make-whole price (plus 15 bps spread) or thereafter at par plus accrued interest. This is a standard debt capital market transaction, not a special situation. No activist, acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring elements are present. The filing is routine financing activity, consistent with ordinary-course liability management.
